author: mathisricoul
quote: Bro, I haven't played this game; I just watched it from streamers. Since I have a PC, I haven't decided to buy it yet, and I won't—I'm thinking about getting a console. From what I saw on the streams, it was lagging, and people tried to use AI to push it to 60 FPS and stuff so it wouldn't lag. They didn't release this game at 60 FPS on purpose so they can sell GTA on the PS6 later saying "we made it 60 FPS"—mark my words, that's the deal with **** for the game itself, the graphics are good, fair enough, I can't say anything against that. The NPCs are good too, but I didn't like the story; something is missing, I couldn't quite figure it out. Also, it's full of bugs, which is normal since it just came out, but the animations are straight-up a mix of RDR2 and GTA 4, nothing has changed apart from that. And this is supposed to be a 13-year development process. That's all I have to say about **** the PC side, I predict the game will come out early because AI tech has advanced so much—there's bound to be a leak. I hope Rockstar planned for this knowing that; if they didn't, modders or people working with AI will port it to PC themselves, and Rockstar will just be left watching. Overall, the game is good, I just couldn't get into it. And those people giving it a 99 on Metascore—when did they even finish the game to give that score? Stop overhyping it, give proper scores, and be fair.
